title: Create an escaped calibration draft
description: This code packages a planted docstring defect as one JSON entry.

steps.description: json provides the encoder for the calibration entry.
draft holds a multi-line docstring. Parameter b has a description but no type.

steps.question: Which criterion does this entry identify as missing?
steps.answer: It identifies missing_C2, because parameter b has no type.

steps.description: entry records an ID, defect label, description, and the full draft text.
json.dumps prints the entry with the multi-line docstring escaped into one JSON string.
